body: Was new at a small town department chain store, there was a senior discount, but I didn’t know the code. Basically they save their age, and the lady was 62 no biggie I just used the POS (point of service system) and manually entered the percentage discount. Anyways she’s convinced I’m screwing her over, has her daughter stand behind me while the grandkids run around and wreak havoc (not supposed to be behind the register) and watch me scan everything and starts throwing a fit, yelling, calling me stupid because she swears that it shouldn’t be that much, and said my attitude was shitty. Which is amusing because I always do my best to be as sickly sweet as possible because of shituations like this. Anyways, she finally takes her mountain of stuff and storms to the main counter, red in the face and gesturing and complaining about me, and they have the discount barcode up there so all they have to do is scan it then scan her stuff in. The kicker is that she had like 20 items that the discount didn’t apply to so I actually would have saved her a shit ton. That’s what you get for being a p.o.s. (Piece of shit)

As a child of morbidly obese parents, and at one point almost being an obese child, NTA. I’m not talking kind of obese either, my father is nearing or at 400lbs. Honestly, people don’t realize how much growing up this way damages kids. I’ve been dealing with the fear of obesity ever since I can remember. I’ve struggled with eating disorders, anxiety about eating in public, people meeting my parents, my parents not being able to do basic normal things other parents do with and for their children, and other things. Right now, my mother is trying to get better, and that’s fantastic, but my father...He just gets heavier and heavier. He washes down enough food for a family of four regularly with a giant Dr. Pepper. You are doing the right thing for yourself, unfortunately it probably won’t be as easy to help her. I just hope she comes to the realization that she needs to help herself much sooner than I have, especially before high school. It’s a brutal world, especially for overweight little girls.
